title: CHEVRON CORP General SEC Filings
source_summary: Recent CVX SEC filings converted into underwriting-oriented disclosure summaries.

fields.title: CHEVRON CORP General SEC Filings
capital_markets_activity: Recent filings include debt issuance and financing-related 8-K disclosure.
capital_allocation_activity: Chevron expects share repurchases in the first quarter of 2026 to be between $2.5-$3.0 billion.
2 Includes excise tax on share repurchases.
liquidity_notes: Recent 10-Q disclosures discuss liquidity needs and management's view of cash flow adequacy.
governance_notes: (d) On January 27, 2026, the board of directors (the “Board”) of Chevron Corporation (the “Corporation”) appointed Thomas W.
Horton was also appointed as a member of the Audit Committee of the Board on the Effective Date.
controls_and_risk_notes: Controls and Procedures (a) Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures The company’s management has evaluated, with the participation of the Chief Executive Officer and the Chief Financial Officer, the effectiveness of the company’s disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rule 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act)) as of the end of the period covered by this report.

(b) Management’s Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting The company’s management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting, as defined in the Exchange Act Rules 13a-15(f) and 15d-15(f).
Risk Factors for further discussion of government action with respect to greenhouse gas and climate change and the associated risks to Chevron’s business.
analyst_relevance: Update debt, interest, and refinancing assumptions from disclosed financing activity.
Reflect buyback pace and remaining authorization in share count and capital allocation assumptions.
Use management liquidity commentary as a check on near-term funding and rating pressure.
Treat governance and control disclosures as qualitative checks rather than direct valuation drivers.
